messages:
maya: starting preflight for the midnight cutover. need a quick sync across api, runtime, console, router. proposed pins: api=v2.3.1, runtime=v7.4.0-quant, console=v1.9.0. router change is a header-based routing flag; planning staged rollout. any blockers?

owen: runtime here. FYI the new kernel alters kv eviction heuristics — could surface p95 regressions at high seq lengths. we need a clear rollback window + a smoke test for kv behavior.

maya: noted. rollback policy proposal: deploy-bot automatic rollback if error_rate > 0.8% (1m window) OR p95 latency degrades > +200ms over baseline for 10m. manual rollback allowed if we see ANY user-facing errors in the first 30m.

deploy-bot: schedule accepted. canary plan: 00:15 UTC 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% deploy. health checks at each step. auto-rollback thresholds set per maya. will post events to #incidents.

liam: router team: i'm going to pin router to legacy-mux for stage1 to reduce coupling. command: `infra pin router=legacy-mux@202403` (will push at T-30m). also adding header-rate-limit sanity check.

owen: runtime smoke test command: 
```
curl -sS https://runtime-health.internal/health | jq .kv_eviction
# expect: {"active":true, "evict_rate":<100/s>}
```
If eviction spikes > 3x baseline, we abort and rollback. i'll run this during canary.

sara: console update: db migration is in read-only mode, UI toggles behind feature flag ready. i've drafted release notes here: https://redwood.company/releases/1738889999-notes (internal). will gate the public note until stage2 complete. customer comms set for 01:30 UTC if all good.

platform-sre: i'll reserve a 20% capacity cushion on infra for the cutover window. alerts: create pager if 3 consecutive 5xx from gateway in 2min. i'll also set ephemeral logs retention to 48h for this rollout.

maya: final guardrails: 1) no increase in customer-facing 5xx > baseline+0.2% 2) kv-smoke pass 3) core evals (prompt set) pass with same token-level quality. if anything fails, deploy-bot will revert pins and route traffic to fallback cluster (runtime:v7.3.9). rollback cmds: 
```
infra unpin router
infra pin api=v2.2.8
infra scale runtime=v7.3.9 --set=weight=100
```
I'll own the manual rollback if auto doesn't trigger.

liam: +1 from router side. I'll keep header routing disabled until stage2. will monitor logs for mismatched routes.

owen: i'll do the kv-stress and smoke at T+5m of canary. will post logs snippet if anything odd.

sara: noted, bumped release notes to 'pending public' and scheduled the post-deploy blog for 02:00 UTC.

platform-sre: monitoring checklist attached: cpu/GPU shm, kv_eviction, p95 latency, error_rate. will open a short-lived zoom at 00:10 UTC.

maya: OK. if no objections by 22:45 UTC i'll trigger the deploy-bot window. last call. :thumbsup:

liam: +1

deploy-bot: deploy window created -> 2024-06-15 00:15 UTC. canary steps and rollback thresholds confirmed. will post updates as events. :rocket:
